payload.title: acceptance still reserved outside the assayer at 9435068c
payload.body: The assayer position says the assayer is the one judge of a unit and nothing else accepts or rejects one. At the landing of assayer-position (9435068c) the assayer's own role, agent and cell say exactly that, but two surfaces outside the unit still give acceptance to the architect: the architect role reserves 'judge(assay)' and 'DECISION accept(unit)' (packages/canon/src/dimensions/role/architect.ts, the reserves line), and the deliver skill's validate and judge laws say self judges the assay and self decides acceptance, with a failed validation 'rejected back' by self (packages/canon/src/skills/deliver/skill.ts, the validate/judge block). By the cut these belong to architect-sees-the-design (architect position) and deliver-loop (integrator position), not to assayer-position, so they were not counted against it; they should be checked when those units are assayed. Separately, docs/role.md's U2 entry still describes the assayer with the old contract (writes C, ¬emits verdict), which the landing contradicts; whether that history entry is left as record or brought up to date is open.
